I wrote the three-step sign-up flow to `./solution.tsx`. I couldn't run it here, so it hasn't been type-checked or tried in a browser. It uses the Orrery kit's `Card`, `Field`, `Input`, `Radio`, `Checkbox` and `Button`, so it should follow whichever brand is active.

- **Progress:** each step shows "Step N of 3" above its title ("Your details", "Your team", "Confirm"). Focus moves to the title when the step changes.
- **Step 1:** "Continue" shows "Enter your name." for an empty name and "Enter a valid email." for an email without an `@`, each under its own field. It doesn't advance until both are fixed. A name of only spaces counts as empty.
